content: Sber: GigaChat API and SaluteSpeech are separate products, separate OAuth tokens/scopes (GIGACHAT_API_PERS vs SALUTE_SPEECH_PERS). Auth = OAuth client credentials -> short-lived access token. SaluteSpeech does speech recognition + TTS. As of 2026-07-15 Sber stopped selling new individual Freemium packages. GigaChat charges input=output token price. gpt2giga (ai-forever) is an official-ish FastAPI proxy exposing OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible surface over GigaChat.
